name: 55372 · Prior Lake, MN
findings: ZIP 55372 (Prior Lake) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55372 (Prior Lake) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
